title: DECtalkMini
description: This project adds DECtalk to minecraft via the chat system
body:
This mod adds DECtalk to minecraft chat!

just like moonbase alpha does, this adds the chaotic TTS system that can sing and talk in your chat!

use various text values such as [iy<1000,25>] for a one second note of "iy" at note 25
you can pick names with text like like [:np] [:nb] and [:nh] before your message
